guitar.evidence: Nancy Wilson is well known for her Ovation acoustic intros (e.g. 'Crazy on You') and Gibson Les Pauls/SGs on electric tracks.

tone.target: bright biting hard-rock riff with wah bite and slight fuzz edge
tone.profile: bright biting hard-rock riff with wah bite and slight fuzz edge
tone.summary: Gate 1 -> Boost (OD 9) -> V-Wah -> Distortion (RAT-style) -> UK 45 -> UK Vintage 4x12 -> Guitar EQ 2 -> Delay -> Room

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum.
Provide aggressive pick attack and tighten the initial signal.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for pre-gain aggression, as OD 9 might be too muddy before wah/distortion.

alternatives.reason: Good general overdrive, but may lose bite compared to a clean boost.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the required bright wah bite for the riff.
Provide tight, biting distortion and fuzz edge without heavy metal gain.
blocks.gap: RAT-style is excellent for aggressive rock tones; Muff-style might be too dark/thick.

alternatives.reason: A safe alternative, but RAT-style better captures the biting aggression.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall/Plexi style amp head for classic hard rock punch.
Provide the classic Marshall-era 4x12 cabinet sound.
Enhance the bright upper mids and overall punch required for the riff.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 to fine-tune specific frequency ranges, focusing on mid-range bite.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative, but EQ 2 offers more precise control for the required upper mids.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the riff without distracting from the core tone.
blocks.gap: Delay is used here for ambience, as a dedicated reverb might muddy the tight rock sound.

alternatives.reason: A warmer alternative, but Digital Delay offers more precise control over rhythmic repeats.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and dimension to the overall mix.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen for its natural, non-metallic decay, fitting the classic rock context.

alternatives.reason: More controlled and bright than Room, but less natural sounding.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance upper mids and bite for the hard rock riff.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper mids and bite for the hard rock riff.
